keyVerseDR: "Come ye after me, and I will make you to be fishers of men." (Mt 4:19)

level1.title: Follow Me!
level1.story: Jesus saw Peter and Andrew fishing. He said, "Follow Me!" They left their nets and followed Jesus.
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
level1.prayer: Jesus, I will follow You. Amen.

activity.title: Fishers of men
activity.intro: Connect the dots to make a fish.

level2.title: Fishers of Men
level2.story: Jesus began to preach, "Repent, for the kingdom of heaven is at hand." Walking by the Sea of Galilee, He saw two brothers, Peter and Andrew, casting a net. "Come after Me, and I will make you fishers of men," Jesus said. At once they left their nets and followed Him. Then He called James and John, who left their boat and their father to follow Jesus.
level2.keyLine: Come ye after me, and I will make you to be fishers of men.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: Why did they follow Jesus right away?
What might Jesus be calling you to do?
level2.prayer: Jesus, help me follow You right away. Amen.
